policy:7c7e1594-1280-4ab8-9cc7-c6c5b272a: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
policy:3c2ed0ed-8c97-4a86-a951-a861d9b6f: All workforce members must authenticate with a second factor. SMS is not an accepted factor.
policy:394576fe-2e63-4bbf-849f-f34a5177f: Every workforce member has a named account. Shared accounts are not permitted.
answer:0ffb78cb-5800-40ff-aa5c-b7c606a6c: Yes. All connections use TLS 1.2 or higher. Older protocol versions are disabled at the load balancer.
answer:2e31aee1-a758-4cb8-9e0e-18177f880: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
